# Japan Travel

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Japan's destinations, attractions, and experiences across prefectures from Okinawa to Miyagi.

Japan Travel is an English-language travel resource covering cultural landmarks, natural attractions, island destinations, and local experiences throughout Japan. The site features destination guides, attraction reviews, and practical travel information for exploring Japan's diverse regions.

## Key Topics

- Japan destinations
- Sendai and Miyagi Prefecture
- Shizuoka and Izu Peninsula
- Tokashiki and Okinawa islands
- Buddhist monuments and temples
- Botanical gardens and nature tourism
- Island activities and snorkeling
- Japanese landmarks and statues
- Orchid sanctuaries
- Local crafts and foraging
- Dogashima coastal attractions
- Sendai Daikannon
- Tokashiki Pass

## Island Destinations & Coastal Experiences

- [Discover Tokashiki](https://en.japantravel.com/feature/tokashiki): Tokashiki island guide featuring snorkeling, crafts & Tokashiki Pass
- [Orchid Sanctuary Dogashima, Izu](https://en.japantravel.com/shizuoka/orchid-sanctuary-dogashima-izu/1939): Dogashima Orchid Sanctuary in Izu featuring 6000 orchids in greenhouses

## Cultural Landmarks & Monuments

- [Sendai Daikannon Statue](https://en.japantravel.com/miyagi/sendai-daikannon/5504): 100m Sendai Daikannon Buddhist statue in Miyagi, world's tallest in 1991
